gpu: AMD Radeon RX 6700, gfx1031 with HSA override 10.3.0

method.microbenchmarks: Real PQ2 tensors from the plain 9B and 27B GGUFs. Independent uniform activations from mt19937 seed 1, quantized by the release HIP plugin. Each arm cycles four times over at least 512 MiB of rotating weights. Eight baseline warmups and one candidate warmup precede six alternating-order pairs. Control calls the released dispatcher directly. All output columns must be nonzero and finite. Candidates must have relative L2 error <=1e-5; byte differences are also recorded. GB/s counts logical weight bytes, not measured DRAM traffic. Development runs with incorrect activation strides or context ABI were excluded.
method.bandwidth: Untraced float4 stream reads, seven samples per allocation size. The initial 512 MiB allocation includes clock ramp. Steady 1 and 2 GiB buffers establish the useful ceiling.
method.serving: 8K context, all GPU layers requested, F16 KV for 9B MTP depth 1, Q8 KV for plain 27B. Baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline processes, two 256-token legs per workload in each process. Throughput pools predicted_n-1 over predicted_ms. Candidate groups four rows for selected two/three-token shapes. The 27B candidate also groups two rows on small single-token attention projections.
method.logit_gate: Main-model logits, 256-token prefill followed by 192 teacher-forced rows in repeating one/two/three-token batches, 4K context, six CPU threads. Input is benchmarks/task.py. Every vocabulary entry is captured. Both models use the same KV types as serving. This tests the main path; natural HTTP MTP tests separately compare text and acceptance counts.
method.coding: Same simulated read/edit/test task as agent.py, 8K context, ubatch 256, batch 2048 for 9B and 1024 for 27B. Greedy, startup excluded. Includes every completed repeat, including slow samples. Cold 9B repeats ABBA then BAAB; cold 27B repeats ABBA. Both also repeat ABBA after a separate inference warmup. Intermittent first-task stalls persist after warmup. All coding tasks passed.
